root_cause: The production exact-source workflow used a stale Netlify MCP proxy credential stored in Supabase Vault. The OIDC bridge itself authenticated correctly, but the downstream Netlify upload returned 401 Unauthorized.
prevention_rule: Before an exact-source Netlify production recovery, refresh the Netlify MCP transport credential, keep the credential server-side, and rerun the canonical production source snapshot with exact-SHA readback.
regression_contract: Production promotion must prove exact main SHA on Netlify and must not treat a ready older deploy as terminal success.
